card.name: Section titles inside cross-references
card.fires_on: Words inside the title of a label section cited in a cross-reference such as "(see ...)" or "[see ...]". It fires on the word or word piece partway through or at the end of the heading.

modes.label: Heading ending
modes.description: Last word or word piece of a cited section title, often just before a closing bracket or number.

modes.label: Partway through heading
modes.description: A piece inside a longer heading word or phrase after "see" or a semicolon.
modes.example: see CONTRAINDICATIONS and PRECAUTIONS , Preexisting<< Ast>>hma)

card.plain: It marks the spot inside a section name that a label points the reader to, like "see Fetal Toxicity".
